thesis: Mohnish Pabrai argues that successful investors do not take risk but instead minimize it by ensuring that any potential loss does not affect their personal financial stability or career. He illustrates this by recounting how he started a business in 1991 using retirement savings and credit cards, knowing that even if the venture failed, he could return to his job and rebuild his wealth.
